newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: DBS Land enters Australian hotel market.
newsitem.headline: DBS Land enters Australian hotel market.

text.p: DBS Land Ltd said on Thursday its hotel arm Raffles Holdings had signed two agreements for the development of a hotel in Sydney, Australia.
It said in a statement Raffles one agreement, with Coles Myer Ltd CML.AX, was to buy a freehold hotel for Singapore $18 million (Australian $16.7 million).
A second agreement was signed with GSP Hotels (Sydney) Pte Ltd for the development of the hotel.
Both were conducted through a subsidiary of Raffles Holdings, MCH Trustee (Sydney) Pte Ltd, it said.
The hotel, when completed in 1999, will have about 360 rooms and will be located in Sydney's retail district close to the financial and commercial districts.
DBS Land said the hotel would be able to take advantage of the increase in tourists from Sydney's hosting of the Olympic Games in the year 2000.
The acquisition of the hotel is conditional upon approvals from various Australian authorities, including the Foreign Investment Review Board, it said.
